conceptualSteps: Supply a cancelled-attempt1 receipt as input to attempt2 work.

cases.title: Optional aid and cancellation conserve stock
cases.preconditions: C02 state; actual existing aid predicates and finite reward source fully satisfied.
conceptualSteps: Existing optional engine awards 100F50W once from its own reserve.
Repeat the optional award and cancellation.

expected.note: Only the original escrow is refunded; independently earned aid remains; no duplicate award.

cases.title: Escrow does not pay an optional debit
cases.preconditions: Hard meal-shared-hearth + shelter-rented reserved: spendable80F20W10G; escrow220F200W110G.
conceptualSteps: Attempt optional repair debit50W before any aid reward.

cases.title: Affordable optional prefix
cases.preconditions: Same state as C15; aid predicates satisfied and reserve funded; later repair predicates can actually be fulfilled.
conceptualSteps: After actual repair completion, award200F100W once.

expected.note: Payment precedes its own reward. This is an accounting example, not a movement/repair schedule.

cases.title: Once-only qualified output
cases.preconditions: C09 state; correct fresh original meal-worker observation and exact direct-source prerequisites fulfilled.
conceptualSteps: Derive fulfillment-fixture.meal-direct-parcel from its own committed work.
Repeat the exact derivation and observation.

cases.title: Defeat wins over commitment
cases.preconditions: C02 state; authoritative batch establishes loss of an irreplaceable required original recipient and main defeat.
conceptualSteps: In the same batch, request commit and award a previously unresolved optional.

expected.note: Terminal freezes the unspent reservation; no automatic refund or work.

cases.title: Funding cannot win
cases.preconditions: C02 or C09 state; selected physical work and final presence incomplete.
conceptualSteps: Request terminal victory through each terminal API.

cases.title: Version/fingerprint/escrow corruption
cases.preconditions: A saved v3 attempt exists.
conceptualSteps: Try loading a v2 snapshot, a different contract fingerprint, or a v3 snapshot whose escrow does not equal its reserved recipes.

expected.note: No inferred escrow, silent migration or guessed refund.

cases.title: Zero-cost recipe is still gated
cases.preconditions: Artificial otherwise valid plan with zero cost in both selected services.
conceptualSteps: Commit, fulfill actual work, then repeat output derivation.

expected.note: Zero-cost does not make a prerequisite automatically true or remove explicit commitment.

cases.title: Final presence belongs to originals and selected outputs
cases.preconditions: C09 state; work/reception history exists.
conceptualSteps: Present a replacement household, the unselected meal parcel, a stale batch, or unknown living state at final victory.

expected.note: Same fresh batch must include selected outputs plus original meal recipient and both original households at their recipe-specific destinations.

cases.title: Source placement is not reception
cases.preconditions: Selected output is initially latent; source and receiving zones are disjoint.
conceptualSteps: Present source placement, an early arrival before eligibility or an arrival from another entity as final receipt.

cases.title: All candidate allocation pairs
cases.preconditions: Use the exact immutable economic-study costs and starting stocks; no optional reward used.
conceptualSteps: Enumerate all9 joint selections in each difficulty.

expected.note: This count does not prove reservation, work geometry or challenge.

cases.title: Native fractional stock is not rounded
cases.preconditions: The eventual native observer cannot represent the actual resource balance exactly in the supported contract.
conceptualSteps: Try confirming a plan through an invented rounded stock reading.

expected.note: No native observer is implemented in S1.

cases.title: Lost selected output does not refund or regenerate
cases.preconditions: C09 state; selected output has become available once and is irreversibly destroyed; minimal fixture has no replacement source.
conceptualSteps: Try cancel, re-derive, choose alternative recipe or award main completion.

expected.note: A future campaign recovery branch must have its own explicit finite certified identity/source/cost; none is supplied here.

cases.title: Optional-only loss
cases.preconditions: Any valid nonterminal main state; an optional-only identity is destroyed.

cases.title: Client cannot set price/refund/receipt
cases.preconditions: Initial or reserved state.
conceptualSteps: Send command fields with a custom amount, negative price, protected-recovery source or client-selected paid flag.

cases.title: Incomplete or mixed service selection
cases.preconditions: Initial hard stock.
conceptualSteps: Omit shelter, repeat meal, use shelter-rented as a meal recipe, or include an unknown extra service.

cases.title: Stale preview after optional change
cases.preconditions: C01 preview expected300F220W120G; actual optional aid then changes spendable to400F270W120G.
conceptualSteps: Confirm using the old displayed balance.

expected.note: Refresh and explicit reconfirmation required even though the new balance is higher.

cases.title: Full save timeline and input restoration
cases.preconditions: Valid save immediately before/after reserve, cancel, commit, output, service completion or terminal.
conceptualSteps: Restore the complete matching snapshot and world.
Discard commands queued in the previous loaded timeline.

expected.note: Earlier legitimate saves restore the complete earlier timeline. No external anti-rollback ledger is claimed; native queue behavior needs S3 evidence.

cases.title: Structural bound and integer overflow
cases.preconditions: Plan declares unsafe summed amounts, a cyclic work dependency, missing world IDs or unsupported native performance/input limits.
conceptualSteps: Validate or compile before running the plan.

expected.note: Do not wrap integers, approximate an unsupported branch count, or invent a missing native operation.
